title: Coalesce SSE lag markers under sustained state-broadcast mailbox overflow
outcome: Sustained producer overflow preserves correctness without multiplying redundant authoritative snapshots, transcript invalidations and tail fetches for losses already covered by the last recovery.
acceptance: An end-to-end test through AppState's real mailbox and broadcaster demonstrates bounded redundant recovery snapshots during sustained overflow and authoritative recovery of the newest covered state.
Coalesce or skip loss markers already covered by the connection's authoritative recovery snapshot without losing repair for later uncovered loss or changing monotonic SSE recovery.
